description: Land Title Settlement Dept- Kaldemulla, Moratuwa D/S/D, Colombo District (7889)
categorisation: The gazette content exclusively concerns the amendment of land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It details specific parcels of land, their cadastral references, and locations, and formally records the expunging of particulars from the land title register. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, which is defined for land and property-related matters such as land registrations, titles, and amendments to title records.
